• PAUL WILLIAMSON is off to Norwich and East Anglia University where he will be studying history and art. • Congratulations to LIONEL MANN upon winning the Civil Service Marathon Championship held in conjunction with the Poly A.A.A./R.R.C.marathon.
Philip Gee added a worthy 2nd in the one lap sprint to his earlier 800 metre third place, and Paul Williamson reaped some of the benefits of consistant training with his effort in the 400 metres.

…o after competing very successfully at the beginning of the season unfortunately pulled a muscle (see you next season), Paul Williamson, who has steadily improved his 400 metres time and is now almost a regular in the 4 x 400 metres relay team, Leo Coy, who has found his niche in the team at 3,000 m…
Charlie Gillett and Philip Gee covered the shorter sprints quite successfully and Paul Williamson made his league debut in the 'B' 400 metres with a good 2nd place.
